instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures a bright office setting with a wooden door in the background. Seated at a white desk in the foreground, the woman with long blonde hair (R1) wearing a black sleeveless top on the left and the woman with short grey hair (R2) wearing a light pink blazer on the right are shaking hands. Both individuals look towards the camera with warm, friendly smiles. On the desk between them lies a black folder, a pen, and documents. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural indoor lighting, creating soft shadows and highlighting a neutral color palette with pink and black accents.

R2 is the short grey-haired participant engaged in the handshake with R1
